answer: Each agent identity is admitted through a zero-knowledge attestation of a TPM/SGX enclave, with the inlet verification circuit checking code hash and nonce freshness; the terrace state tree commits accepted identities, while walnut is the consensus-contract hash anchor. Forging requires compromising a distinct hardware root or producing a valid enclave proof; identities bond on quadratic bonding curves O(N^2), and failed proofs trigger irreversible collateral slashing.
